entries.title: Pinned tasks no longer bring their finished parts along
entries.body: In the Tasks panel, a pinned task's parts that are already done now stay under done · 7d instead of crowding Pinned. Its open parts, and any part you pinned yourself, still list under it. The iPhone and iPad Tasks tab does the same.

picture.alt: The Tasks panel with a pinned task and its two open parts under Pinned, and its two finished parts listed under done · 7d
